source: CRON 20261014: Nigeria Real Estate Investment Trust Fund Q2 2026 financial statements, statement of comprehensive income for the half year ended 30 June 2026, Group column (NGX doclib filing library), printed in NGN thousands and scaled to naira. Total income 7,968,347 less the printed operating expenses 1,919,063 equals the printed profit before tax 6,049,284, which is also the printed profit after tax because the fund charged no tax for the period, so no income tax row is written. The filing prints no earnings per unit line for the half year. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929: audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025 (N'000) | CRON 20260929_195546: period list cut from five to two: the statement presents two GROUP columns and two FUND columns, and the FUND figures had been stored against FY2023 and FY2022 while the 2025 GROUP figure was repeated under FY2021. Only the two GROUP years are stored now. This fund presents no cost of sales, no gross profit and no finance cost line.
